Recursive Learning

We're here to do recursive eco-improvement. Recursive self-improvement can fail in several ways, because a thing that improves itself still has to adapt with its environment, or adapt the environment. This is where that hypothesis gets tested at the sizes we actually work at.

One channel of recursive.eco, held in git: the film, the game, and the grammars about AI and about learning alongside it. Every grammar below can be opened, starred onto your own channel, forked, or corrected.

Play

As-If — a recognition round Hold the premise as true and write what changes. The card only turns over once you have.
